---
description: "Brewboard - verify the current user and connection, sign in (--login) or sign out (--logout)"
---
Run the Brewboard `init` subcommand, exactly as `/bb init` with the arguments below; this entry has no workflow of its own.

Read ~/.bb/skill/SKILL.md and follow its init workflow for the rest of this request. Signing in follows the sign-in step of the init section: run `bb.py init --login --launch --format table`, which opens the sign-in in a new terminal. Never run `bb.py init --login` or `bb.py init` yourself: they need a real terminal for the hidden password prompt.

Subcommand and arguments: init $ARGUMENTS
